title: Mixed Event — An Unmissable Spirited Affair — Episode7 Together 'Til The End

meta.Event Outline: Kamiyama High School's second-years are headed to Kyoto! In contrast with Tsukasa's excitement for their school trip, Rui is less enthused. But will his feelings change when one of his classmates approaches him?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
The parade seems to be about half over.
At this rate...

rows.Speaker: Miyake
rows.Line: I guess we're not gonna be able to watch it together...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
No, don't give up...!
It's not over yet! If we just keep looking...

rows.Speaker: Tourists
rows.Line:
Wow...!
What is that?! It's so pretty!

rows.Speaker: Tourists
rows.Line:
Wait, it's snowing!
But just around that girl...!
How are they doing that?!

rows.Speaker: Tourists
rows.Line:
I don't believe it...
That girl with the white haori looks like a real yuki-onna...

rows.Speaker: Tourists
rows.Line: I can't believe they're getting it to snow!

rows.Speaker: Tourists
rows.Line: Wait, she looks familiar... Where have I seen her before...?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (Just like Kamishiro said. Raise your right arm and...)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Hah hah hah hah!
I should expect no less from our director! Bravo!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Don't forget about Shizuku!
That frosty look on her face... It's like she's the real thing!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
Hehe.
It's certainly hard to miss them.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Kamishiro, I see Tsukasa and the others...!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes, I just saw them as well!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: We'll wait for you guys at the end!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I have to say, Rui, your idea was spectacular!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah, I don't think any of us were expecting you to make yourselves seen like that.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Yes, not only was it unexpected, but you had all the other onlookers completely captivated.

rows.Speaker: Miyake
rows.Line:
You totally blew everyone away!
You really are a genius, Kamishiro...!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: However, if all eyes were really on us...

rows.Speaker: Tourists
rows.Line: I wasn't really sure when she walked past us, but isn't that Shizuku Hinomori...?

rows.Speaker: Tourists
rows.Line:
Yeah, it's gotta be her!
Wanna go say hi?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Nonsense. All we have to do is use this crowd for cover.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Now, let's enjoy this parade together!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Whoa! I don't think these count as costumes anymore! They look like real spirits from folklore!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Yes, they're very realistic.
I believe they're inspired by namahage.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: That rokurokubi...! Her neck just keeps growing longer and longer! How are they doing that...?!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Her head looks way too real!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: That person dressed as a tengu must have incredible balance. Their sandals look like stilts...

rows.Speaker: Taniyama
rows.Line: Imagine seeing one of those at night! I bet we'd all scream while running for our lives!

rows.Speaker: Miyake
rows.Line: Haha. I'm not sure we'd be that scared...

rows.Speaker: Taniyama
rows.Line:
Geez, you really got us!
Miyake even fell over!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Oh, Rui, look!
The floats are coming! This must be the finale!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
It's like a climactic scene!
All those spirits...! And only I, Tsukasa Tenma the Spirit Busting High Schooler can defeat them!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Hehe. In Kyoto no less.
That certainly sounds like a fun action-adventure story.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Exactly!
Oh, and that black tengu would be the final boss! No, he'd be my enemy at first, but later my ally...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (Because I wouldn't have been able to see this event with them if I hadn't.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (Not only that, our school trip is the only reason we did anything together at all.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Well, I guess that's it for today...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes, quite a lot happened along the way, but it ended up being a wonderful day.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Thanks for having us, you guys!

rows.Speaker: Miyake
rows.Line: N-No... We should be the ones thanking you. You made the day just that much better.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
I agree!
What we experienced today will surely remain in our album of memories for years to come!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: How about we take a group photo together?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Yes.
I'd like to have something to commemorate this day with.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Yes, I'd like that as well!
Oh, but my phone's battery is still...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Then, we can use mine!
I'll see if one of the staff can take it for us!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Why this all of a sudden, Rui...?
You never usually suggest doing anything like this.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: But I thought it'd be nice to for a change.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Bunch together you guys!
Get ready!
